Resource Profile: PH Core Immunization

Official URL: https://fhir.doh.gov.ph/phcore/StructureDefinition/ph-core-immunization Version: 0.2.1
Draft as of 2026-10-23 Maturity Level: 0 Computable Name: PHCoreImmunization

Describes the event of a patient being administered a vaccine or a record of an immunization as reported by a patient, a clinician or another party.

Usages:

  • Refer to this Profile: PH Core Observation
  • Examples for this Profile: Immunization/immunization-single-example
  • CapabilityStatements using this Profile: CapabilityStatement[https://fhir.doh.gov.ph/phcore/CapabilityStatement/PHCoreServerCapabilityStatement|0.2.1]

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
